items.title: Neha Bora (AISA) at the Dilli Chalo march: 'This is exactly what democracy looks like'
items.summary: AISA president Neha Bora, marching in the Dilli Chalo march to the Supreme Court, said people have not forgotten democracy: 'This is exactly what democracy looks like. Do you think that by blocking roads, closing metro stations, and cancelling trains, you can stop democracy from coming? You may forget democracy, but the people of this country who have shed their blood have not forgotten democracy, which is why we are on the streets.' ANI-wire quote carried by indianeconomicobserver.com and webindia123.com; same wire, so single-sourced. First new statement from Bora since her march participation was confirmed.
